question: The Annual Boat Race Festival is held in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Onam is the festival during which boat races are celebrated in Kerala.
 
• The Vallam Kali, also known as the boat race, is a traditional event held during the Onam festival.
 
• Onam is an annual harvest festival celebrated predominantly in the Indian state of Kerala.
 
• The festival commemorates the homecoming of the legendary King Mahabali.
 
• It is celebrated with numerous festivities including boat races, cultural programs, traditional games, and elaborate feasts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Onam is celebrated in the month of Chingam, which is the first month of the Malayalam calendar (August-September).
 
• The festival lasts for ten days, starting on Atham and culminating on Thiruvonam.
 
• The Snake Boat Race is one of the most iconic events during Onam, attracting participants and spectators from all over the world.
 
• Other major attractions include the pookalam (floral arrangements), Onasadya (grand feast), and traditional dances like Thiruvathira and Pulikali.
 
• Onam is a symbol of unity and prosperity, bringing together people of all communities and religions in Kerala.
